The Client–Server Model: storyboard

Episode 3 · voice Jessica · 12 scenes · 81.1s (measured timing) · one still per beat, 8 frames after it fires

hook hook FlowDiagram · 0.0s–5.4s

Headline: One idea. Every app.

“Every web app you've ever used is built on one idea: the client-server model.”

branding sting 5.4s–6.9s

Bite wipe → logos → cut. No voiceover, just the chomp.

idea idea Analogy · 6.9s–17.5s

Headline: Order up!

“Think restaurant. You're the client: you order. The waiter carries it to the kitchen, that's the server. It cooks, and your food comes back.”

breakdown history Tiers · 17.5s–25.4s

Headline: How we got here

“First, one giant mainframe did everything. Then your PC did it all alone. Then the web split the job.”

breakdown request Sequence · 25.4s–31.7s

No headline

“Tap a button, and your browser sends a request: a tiny message saying what you want.”

breakdown backend Sequence · 31.7s–35.9s

No headline

“The backend checks the rules, then asks the database for your data.”

breakdown response Sequence · 35.9s–41.3s

No headline

“It packs the answer into a response and sends it back. Usually in under a second.”

breakdown roles Analogy · 41.3s–47.5s

Headline: Show vs. decide

“So the client shows things, and the server decides things. Never trust the client with the rules.”

breakdown twotier Split · 47.5s–55.7s

Headline: Two tiers: risky

“Some apps are two-tier: the client talks straight to the database. Simple, but risky: anyone can poke your data.”

breakdown threetier Tiers · 55.7s–62.4s

Headline: Three tiers win

“Three-tier puts a server in the middle. Client, server, database: each with one job.”

breakdown crowd FlowDiagram · 62.4s–67.5s

No headline

“Now a million people show up at once, and one server starts to melt.”

breakdown scale FlowDiagram · 67.5s–73.6s

Headline: Go wide, not tall

“Don't buy one bigger server. Add more servers, put a load balancer in front, and spread the load.”

gist gist GistCard · 73.6s–81.1s

No headline

“That's the gist: clients ask, servers answer, and more servers answer more clients. Follow for more.”
